encounter._doc: Encounter agents — orbs, scouts, watchers. Rendered as unshaded emissive primitives; collision via kind-specific radius.

debug._doc: Debug + fixture-only primitives (shadow_orb, test beacons). Not used by gameplay — safe to edit freely without regression risk.

orb.description: Roaming encounter agent. Rendered as an unshaded emissive sphere in the world; on camera contact begins an EncounterSession with the actor_id carried on the entity. Spawned by core/systems/roaming_pool.py, not by the stamp density table.

shadow_orb.description: Shadow lab fixture — floating orb + decal_projector. Not used by gameplay; iterated at shadow_lab anchor (slot (-2, 0)).
